_comment: Resource tiers: ONE application, several resource profiles.  The interfaces (profile packs, runtime, database schema, assistant API) never change between tiers; only these numbers do.  These are the FIXED fallback profiles. The running product computes its own plan from the hardware (vgpt/scale/plan.py, explained in docs/SCALING.md) and corrects it by measurement; the Raspberry Pi 4 and laptop figures are in results/scaling/.

edge2g.label: Reference board: 2 ARM A5x cores, 2 GB RAM (the case study's constraint)
edge2g.notes: one model context; one year of numerical history and five years of durable records

pi5.label: Raspberry Pi 5 (4 x A76, 8 GB) or an automotive Cortex-A76 board
pi5.notes: same model, more threads; twice the fine history

vm8.label: Virtual machine / validation rig: 8 vCPU, 16 GB
vm8.notes: three model contexts: three questions in flight at once; a year of minute history for a fleet-sized replay

hpc.label: Vehicle HPC: 8-16 Cortex-A7x cores, 16-32 GB
hpc.notes: the same 0.5B model and interfaces; more workers and a larger data tier, not a different model
